notes: Standard hotel check-in is 2:00 PM and check-out is 12:00 noon (local time). Early check-in and late check-out are subject to availability and may carry a charge.
Airport transfers are included on the arrival and departure days listed in the itinerary. Transfers for flights arriving or departing outside those windows can be arranged at additional cost.

Breakfast is served at the hotel and typically offers both continental and local options, vegetarian and non-vegetarian. Jain and other specific meal requirements can usually be arranged with advance notice.
Indian restaurants are available near most of the hotels we use across Vietnam, Bali, Thailand and Malaysia. Your planner will share options for each city before you fly.
Timings in this document are indicative. The order of activities may shift with weather, traffic and local operating hours — your trip planner confirms the final day plan before departure.
Hotels listed are the properties we book most often. If a specific hotel is unavailable for your dates, we substitute a property of the same or higher category and confirm it with you in writing.
Prices are per person on twin-sharing basis unless stated otherwise. Single-occupancy supplements apply and are quoted separately.
Rates are not applicable during major festival periods (Diwali, Christmas, New Year) and peak-season blackout dates, when a revised quote will be shared.
paymentTerms: A booking advance is required to confirm hotels and services; the balance is due before departure as set out in your booking confirmation.
Card and payment-gateway transactions may carry a processing charge, which is always shown to you before you confirm.
Package prices are dynamic and subject to change until the booking is confirmed and the advance is received.
Applicable GST and TCS are charged as per prevailing Indian government regulations.
Refunds, where applicable under the cancellation policy, are processed only through the original mode of payment within 15 working days of the cancellation request.

whyUs.title: One planner, start to finish
whyUs.copy: The person who builds your itinerary is the same person answering your message at 11pm from Krabi. No handoffs, no call centre.

whyUs.title: Real prices, up front
whyUs.copy: Every price on our site and in this document is a real number you can plan around. No "price on request", no surprises at the end.

whyUs.title: Depth over breadth
whyUs.copy: We sell four countries, not forty. Every route in this document has been walked by someone on our team, hotel by hotel.

whyUs.title: Fixed before you notice
whyUs.copy: Delays, closures and weather get re-planned while you are still in the air. 24/7 on-trip support is standard on every booking.

whyUs.title: Built around you
whyUs.copy: Want to swap a city, add two nights or drop the 5am trek? Say so. We rebuild the plan until it reads like your holiday, not a template.
